page.overview:
Who is The Minister?

The Minister is a character that appeared in Tekken: Kazuya's Revenge. He is the semi-antagonist of the film. His men kidnapped Kazuya and Kazuya is forced to be an assassin for The Minister. Later on, The Minister is killed by Rhona because she did not want to work with him anymore.
